card.name: Words right before a verb phrase
card.fires_on: Linking words and punctuation (that, to, a comma, They) that sit just before a verb describing what someone or something does or can do. Seen in general web prose, not drug labels.

modes.label: Relative or linking word
modes.description: The word 'that' or 'to' after a noun or adjective, leading into a verb.
modes.example: fragile skin<< that>> tears or bruises easily (bruising may

modes.label: Sentence-start pronoun or comma
modes.description: A pronoun or comma that starts a new clause about a subject's traits or abilities.
modes.example: Industrial robots are capable of performing with precision and repeatability.<< They>> are also extremely strong.

card.writes: Promotes odd Chinese and mixed-language tokens, so no clear effect on English output.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words that come just before a verb saying what something does or can do.
